split_tensor_along_last_dim: split a PyTorch tensor into equal partitions along its last dimension for model parallelism
ensure_divisibility: assert that a numerator is evenly divisible by a given denominator and raise an error if not
divide: safely divide a numerator by a denominator after asserting the numerator is evenly divisible
vocab_range_from_per_partition_vocab_siz: compute the start and end vocabulary index range for a given rank and per-partition vocab size
vocab_range_from_global_vocab_size: compute the start and end vocabulary index range for a given rank from a global vocab size
